1. Cleanup is not guaranteed on failure inside the template body
Location: Line 1064 in redfish/managers/test_bmc_config_ipv6.robot
Current Code:
    Restore Network Configuration And Cleanup

Issue: Restore Network Configuration And Cleanup is only called on the success path of the template body keyword. If configuration, address polling, or Redfish validation fails earlier, the test can exit before restoration runs.

Impact: A failed iteration can leave DHCPv4, SLAAC, DHCPv6, or static IP state modified on the target BMC, contaminating later template iterations and making failures harder to diagnose.

Recommendation: Move restoration into a teardown path that always runs for each iteration, or wrap the body in a failure-safe cleanup structure so restoration executes even when an intermediate step fails.
